query: What quasi-experimental designs (RD, DiD, IV) have credibly identified causal effects of digital literacy on college access, and which instruments or discontinuities were effective?

response.query: What quasi-experimental designs (RD, DiD, IV) have credibly identified causal effects of digital literacy on college access, and which instruments or discontinuities were effective?
response.answer: Quasi-experimental designs like Difference-in-Differences (DiD) have credibly identified causal effects of digital literacy on college access, using policy changes as effective instruments.
